E_scope_and_fairness.details: The current protocol and current analyzer restrict interpretation to one validation seed, 24 sources x 3 fixed offsets, one shared cached construction, unchanged goals/thresholds, and a diagnostic decision about this root-translation parameterization. They expressly exclude innovation, efficacy acceptance, C1/C2/C3 replacement, G1, downstream training, held-out test, semantics, and diversity claims. The current analyzer now bases continuation wording on positive paired joint gain or physical-pass improvement versus baseline. Because only baseline exists, no treatment conclusion is available.

F_evaluation_classification.details: The tracking target is a model/simulator-derived synthetic reference, and physical quantities are simulator/geometry proxies. No human evaluation or real-world ground truth is present.

source_and_body_order.details: The independent witness verified the manifest-derived case/text/target-joint order, 72 metrics/cases, 24 sources with three offsets each, and a contiguous valid prefix for every case. Preparation resolves each foot by body name before indexing. Preparation itself should have asserted case/trajectory/body-axis alignment before writing references rather than relying on the later witness.

contact_frame_com.details: Collision primitives are read in body-local coordinates, rotated to world coordinates, lowered by primitive radius, and the lowest surface proxy is selected. V19-established COM linear velocity is converted to the selected point velocity using v_COM + omega x (point - COM). Support uses simulated vertical body force and surface height. This is internally consistent for the declared simulator/geometry proxy; it is not a measured contact-manifold or real-contact truth.

reference_geometry.details: All three references are finite 120x72x24x3 arrays with identical targets. Frames 0-60 and all Z coordinates are exact. Horizontal translation is shared across bodies and bounded below 0.10 m. Maximum shifts are 0.0607537857 m (unconstrained) and 0.0607520330 m (endpoint-preserved); endpoint-preserved final translation is exactly zero. All 72 inputs were complete, so the declared incomplete-case rule was not exercised in this run.

original_goals.details: Each reference archive carries the same original-goal array; the baseline execution goal hash and case order match the frozen source. Treatment-arm execution has not occurred.

reset_and_time_alignment.details: The baseline initial reset gate passed; seven exported reset tensors and four named rigid-body cache checks matched; the initial XY anchor error was zero; frames were exactly 0..119. The temporal claim is limited to a shared transition index: reference/observation k is recorded before action k, while actual k is recorded after that action. This is not simultaneous pre-action reference/actual sensing. Equal reset state across three arms is not yet testable.
